title: Patient Payment Plans Credit Policy: Crediting Recent Payments after Returned Payments
content:
When a charge posted for an encounter already enrolled on a proposed Patient Payment Plans plan is enrolled, which payments applied to the charge are credited against its counted amount follows the returned payments on the patient's Patient Financial Account.

**Measure.** The returned payments are counted as the payment reversals the Patient Financial Account shows posted less than 12 whole months before the enrollment date, across the whole account. They are compared with the account's returned-payment restriction count (the number of returned payments, set by the account's financial class, after which check and ACH are no longer accepted).

**Policy.**

1. With at least the account's returned-payment restriction count of reversals, check and ACH payments posted less than one whole month before the enrollment date are not credited, and every other payment applied to the charge is.
2. With at least one reversal but fewer than the account's returned-payment restriction count, check payments posted less than one whole month before the enrollment date are not credited, and every other payment applied to the charge is.
3. With no reversal, every payment applied to the charge is credited.

A payment not credited is not subtracted in working out the charge's remaining balance.

| Payment reversals on the account, less than 12 whole months before enrollment | Recent check payment (less than one whole month before) | Recent ACH payment (less than one whole month before) | Card or older payments |
|---|---|---|---|
| At least the restriction count | Not credited | Not credited | Credited |
| At least one, below the restriction count | Not credited | Credited | Credited |
| None | Credited | Credited | Credited |

**Example (hypothetical, restriction count of 2).** A charge of 300.00 carries a check payment of 50.00 posted two weeks before the enrollment date, an ACH payment of 70.00 posted one week before it and a card payment of 30.00 posted three months before it.

- Two reversals on the account in the period: only the card payment is credited; 30.00 is credited.
- One reversal: the ACH and card payments are credited; 100.00 is credited.
- No reversal: all three are credited; 150.00 is credited.
